abstract: Choriocarcinoma limited to placenta was discovered "incidentally" following a seemingly uneventful term pregnancy. The newborn had unsuspected severe anemia and thrombocytopenia, due to fetomaternal hemorrhage. His recovery was good following transfusions. The mother was asymptomatic and her extensive workup for metastatic choriocarcinoma was negative. She was subsequently managed expectantly and monitored with serial serum beta-hCG, demonstrating near-logarithmic decline to non-pregnant levels within 5 weeks of delivery.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌が、一見問題のなかった正期妊娠の後に偶発的に発見され、胎盤に限局していた。新生児は胎児母体間出血による重度の貧血と血小板減少を認めたが、輸血により良好に回復した。母体は無症状であり、転移性絨毛癌に関する詳細な検索は陰性であった。母体は待機的に管理され、血清β-hCGは分娩後5週間以内に非妊娠時のレベルまでほぼ対数的に低下した。
